# Dora

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** pupil  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora is a neat and proper child with gentle, mild hazel eyes and a straight nose. She has long, sleek curls that always stay in order and possesses chubby fingers suited for small tasks. She dresses impeccably, wearing a nicely starched white dress accented by a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)_

## Personality

Dora is a lovely, meek, and demure young girl who is described as being exceptionally good, quiet, and well-behaved. She is notably prim and proper, often sitting, acting, and speaking in a restrained manner, though some find her nature rather monotonous. Industrious, faithful, neat, and observant, she works carefully, systematically, and dispassionately, never needing to be told how to perform a task twice or forgetting her duties. Even in difficult circumstances, she remains pale yet quite composed.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), +9 more_

## History

Dora and her twin brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) were brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) after being orphaned. Soon after her arrival, she was coaxed into a pigpen by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and had water pumped over her, and later was locked in a toolhouse when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) trapped her and lied about her whereabouts. Her staying at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) became permanent after the death of her uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), who left money for the twins' care. While attending school, she was frightened of staying in the dark after a classmate shared ghost stories with her.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), +10 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dora.md)

Dora is a student of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who helps care for her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) actively protects Dora's well-being, such as when she searched for Dora after she went missing and discovered her locked in a toolhouse. Their household dynamic involves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offering gentle guidance while managing the household and the mischief caused by Dora's twin brother.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +6 more_

- Student of  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is Dora's twin brother. Their relationship is marked by Davy's frequent targeted mischief and pranks against her, such as tricking her into a pigpen, pumping water over her, complaining about her to others, and locking her inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +18 more_

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +7 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) acts as a guardian to Dora, having brought her and her twin brother to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as orphans. On occasion, Dora acts as a traveling companion to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), such as accompanying her on trips into town.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +6 more_

- Comrade of — travelling companion to town  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001)</sub>
